gaps.snippet: impl < E : 'static , F : 'static > Transducer < E , F > { # [doc = " Construct a transducer from a raw transformation function."] # [doc = ""] # [doc = " Prefer the named constructors (`map`, `filter`) for common shapes."] pub fn new (description : impl Into < String > , f : impl Fn (Vec < E >) -> Vec < F > + 'static) -> Self { Transducer { transform : Box :: new (f) , description : description . into () , } } # [doc = " Apply the transformation to a `Vec<E>`, producing a `Vec<F>`."] # [doc = ""] # [doc = " Called by [`crate::transduce`]; not usually called directly."] pub (crate) fn apply (& self , v : Vec < E >) -> Vec < F > { (self . transform) (v) } # [doc = " A human-readable description of the step pipeline (EXPLAIN artifact, C3)."] # [must_use] pub fn describe (& self) -> & str { & self . description } # [doc = " Compose `self` with `next`: `self.compose(next)` applies `self` first, then `next`."] # [doc = ""] # [doc = " The resulting transducer's description lists both steps in order (C3 / EXPLAIN)."] # [doc = ""] # [doc = " # Associativity"] # [doc = " `compose` is associative: `(t1.compose(t2)).compose(t3)` and"] # [doc = " `t1.compose(t2.compose(t3))` produce the same output for every input. This is asserted"] # [doc = " empirically in tests (spec §7-Q5; NOT tagged `Proven` without a checked theorem — VR-5)."] pub fn compose < G : 'static > (self , next : Transducer < F , G >) -> Transducer < E , G > { let desc = format ! ("{} → {}" , self . description , next . description) ; Transducer { transform : Box :: new (move | v | next . apply (self . apply (v))) , description : desc , } } }
